_source: Extracted + genericized from traditional_template/admin/data/footer.json. Now wired to components/footer/footer.php via FooterController - see that class. traditional_template's own audit found a duplicate/dead footer-links data source (nav.json's 'footer' array vs. footer.json's 'quick_links', only one ever actually read) - this file's original 'quick_links' key had exactly that problem here too (config/navigation.json's 'footer' array, read through NavigationService::menu('footer'), already covers that same content and is the one FooterController actually calls). Removed it rather than carry the duplicate forward; 'items' below is a genuinely distinct second column, not a duplicate of anything. Same story for social links: FooterController.php reads 'socials' from SettingsService::socials() (config/settings.json's 'social' object), not from this file - a duplicate 'socials' block used to live here too and was removed. To add a Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp URL, edit config/settings.json's 'social' object - SettingsService::socials() already array_filter()s out empty ones, so filling one in is the only step needed for its icon to appear.
